description: This Java class, GenericEntityUtils, provides a utility method to determine the entity class associated with a generic class in the context of SalesManagerEntity types, through reflection.

classes.name: GenericEntityUtils
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for reflecting and extracting generic type information related to SalesManagerEntity subclasses.

methods.name: getGenericEntityClassFromComponentDefinition
methods.description: Returns the Class object representing the generic entity class that extends SalesManagerEntity within the given class's hierarchy.
